Newbuilds | Remote Senior Ruby on Rails Developer | Remote (Europe) | Full-time

Newbuilds is hiring a Senior Ruby on Rails Developer to help scale a widely used proptech marketing platform, a Norway-based proptech company powering automated campaigns and data-driven workflows across 17+ countries.

You’ll work on backend architecture, improve performance and scalability, build integrations with external APIs/CRMs, and influence technical direction with ownership over your code. This role is remote-first with flexible work and competitive senior-level compensation.

Remote (EU timezone friendly) | We work via B2B, or employment in Norway or Germany

Modern stack: PostgreSQL, Sidekiq, RabbitMQ, AWS, Docker, GraphQL

Join a low-ego engineering team with real product impact

Apply or share with someone who’d love working on complex backend challenges: https://careers.staffer.ai/jobs/7247377-remote-senior-ruby-o...
